entry.title: Creating Custom Lottie Animations With SVGator

entry.title: Why Anticipatory Design Isn’t Working For Businesses
entry.summary: Anticipatory design, powered by Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine learning (ML), and Big Data (BD), promises to transform user experiences by predicting and fulfilling needs before users even express them. While this proactive approach seems revolutionary, many businesses struggle to meet the high expectations it sets.
